NMTS Saturday Easy Group Ride

Albuquerque, NM · Road

Beginner friendly

NMTS Saturday Easy Group Ride is a road group ride in Albuquerque, NM. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Open Space Shining River parking lot. About 15 miles, about 13 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the NMTS Saturday Easy Group Ride group ride

A short, easy Saturday ride at around 13 mph, about 15 miles. The gentlest ride on the club's weekly list and a reasonable first group ride in Albuquerque. Helmet required.
